# Lotus Bloom Nails & More

> Boho beauty studio in Thessaloniki offering manicures, pedicures, gel extensions, lash lift and brow design. Bilingual site (Greek / English).

- [Gallery](/gallery): Nail art portfolio — signature manicures, gel extensions and hand-painted designs.
- [Privacy Policy](/privacy): How visitor data is handled.
- [Terms of Service](/terms): Booking and usage terms.
